evals.prompt: i cloned bare-expo and added autopass. how do i actually run my backend bundle? i see references to bare-pack but no example with the right hosts
evals.expected_output: Full bare-pack invocation with --host ios-arm64 / ios-arm64-simulator / ios-x64-simulator / android-arm64 / android-x64, --linked, --out app/app.bundle.mjs, backend entrypoint.

evals.prompt: my backend module errors with `AddonError: ADDON_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find addon` on ios. what's missing?
evals.expected_output: Addon not built for arch, or not linked into node_modules/react-native-bare-kit/ios/addons. Suggests logging Bare.platform/Bare.arch, rerunning bare-pack --linked, clearing native build cache.

evals.prompt: how do i actually send a message from my react native screen down to the bare backend?
evals.expected_output: RPC via bare-rpc over Worklet IPC pipe; shared enum file for opcodes; example with rpc.request and a handler on the backend.

assertions.value: Shows both the RN side (rpc.request) and the Bare side (rpc handler) of a complete RPC round-trip.

evals.prompt: the os keeps suspending my app and i lose my swarm connection. how do i handle this on mobile?
evals.expected_output: Subscribe to Bare 'suspend'/'idle'/'resume' events, destroy swarm on suspend, re-create on resume.

evals.prompt: my worklet exits silently and nothing logs. how do i find out what crashed?
evals.expected_output: Register Bare.on('uncaughtException', ...) and Bare.on('unhandledRejection', ...); tail iOS log stream (subsystem=='bare') or Android logcat.

assertions.value: Recommends platform-appropriate log tailing (iOS log stream or Android logcat).
